newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active in the the Panhandle area late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 higher than last week's close.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 53,800 slaughter steers and 25,500 slaughter heifers. 95,900 head confirmed for the week to date including 7 loads or 300 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00. Select, few choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00-67.50.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00. Few select, few choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 67.00.
Wk to Date: 95,900 Week Ago: 86,600 Year Ago: 80,100
